data.title: Lifestyle Sister Rosetta Tharpe Tour Jacket
data.description: This limited quantity, vintage-inspired satin tour/bomber jacket features "Sister Rosetta Tharpe" on the back and a rose on the left chest. 100% nylon satin Unisex sizing Cold water wash only, with like colors, on a delicate spin. Low heat dry is best to help protect the fabric.

data.description: This mechanic jacket features a "Music City USA" graphic screen printed on the back. Built from the origins of traditional American workwear, this jacket has a classic silhouette and is unlined, making it slightly more lightweight, breathable, and versatile than some of the heavier imogene + willie jackets. Inspired by long hours in the garage and the days when clothes were built to take a beating, each jacket is patterned, cut, and sewn in the USA from American-made fabric. 65% polyester, 35% cotton twill Fits true to size Wash cold, hang to dry

Farewell Tour® is an apparel brand created for guitar players. With patents issued in the USA and in Europe for guitar pick pocket garments, Farewell Tour® provides players easy accessibility to their guitar picks while playing. The brand’s mission is to create high quality products for everyday guitar players as well as touring artists. 65% cotton, 35% polyester Unisex sizing Machine wash cold, hang dry

data.description: This premium quality White Farewell Tour x Gibson Gold Logo Tee is made in collaboration with Farewell Tour® and features their patented guitar pick pocket. Farewell Tour® is an apparel brand created for guitar players. With patents issued in the USA and in Europe for guitar pick pocket garments, Farewell Tour® provides players easy accessibility to their guitar picks while playing. The brand’s mission is to create high quality products for everyday guitar players as well as touring artists. 100% cotton Unisex sizing Machine wash cold, hang dry

data.title: Lifestyle H Bar C x Gibson J200 Tencel Mens Shirt
data.description: This stylish black and gold men's shirt is the result of a collaboration between Gibson and legendary Western wear maker H Bar C. It is made from Tencel® fabric and features a design inspired by the iconic Gibson J-200. Tencel is a washable, sustainable, environmentally friendly fabric with a silky feel. Whether you're onstage or out for a night at the local honky-tonk, you'll both look and feel great in this shirt! Gibson logo on the back 100% Tencel fabric Wash cold. Tumble dry low.

data.title: Lifestyle H Bar C x Gibson J200 Odessa Unisex Jacket
data.description: This stylish black and gold Odessa unisex jacket is the result of a collaboration between Gibson and legendary Western wear maker H Bar C. Made in the style of classic tour jackets, it features a design inspired by the iconic Gibson J-200. Whether you're onstage or out for a night at the local honky-tonk, you'll stay warm and look great in this jacket! Faux "pockets," zipper closure Gibson logo on the back 100% Polyester Wash cold. Tumble dry low.

data.title: Lifestyle Tristar Les Paul Tee Apparel
data.description: This comfortable gray tee features the Gibson logo, a Les Paul™ silhouette, the Tri-Star emblem from the Tennessee state flag, and a shout-out to our home city of Nashville. Unisex sizing 50% polyester, 25% cotton, and 25% rayon fabric blend Care instructions: Cold water only, with like colors, on a delicate spin. Low heat dry is best to help protect the fabric.

data.title: Lifestyle Tristar Pullover Hoodie Apparel
data.description: This warm and comfortable charcoal Pullover Hoodie features the Gibson logo, the Tri-Star emblem from the Tennessee state flag, and a shout-out to our home city of Nashville. Tumble dry low. See label for care instructions.

data.title: Lifestyle Billy Reid x Gibson Dover Crewneck Sweatshirt
data.description: Straight from Muscle Shoals to Music Row, and now, to you, Gibson has partnered with award-winning Florence, Alabama-based fashion designer Billy Reid on a very limited collection inspired by the iconic Gibson Hummingbird™ guitar. For this collectible version of Billy Reid’s iconic Dover Sweatshirt, they’ve embroidered Billy’s original “Kissing Hummingbirds” design to the chest using a chain stitch technique. It also features Billy Reid’s signature distressed leather elbow patches, piping details at the armhole, subtle herringbone twill detailing throughout, and a special collaboration patch at the back bottom left hem. Billy calls this one “Sophisticated, but rock n’ roll.” 80% Cotton, 20% polyester Made in Canada Ribbed cuffs and hem Machine wash cold Model is 6'2" wearing size M Standard fit Relaxed through the chest, body, and sleeves

data.title: Lifestyle Billy Reid x Gibson Crewneck Billy Reid
data.description: Straight from Muscle Shoals to Music Row, and now, to you, Gibson has partnered with award-winning Florence, Alabama-based fashion designer Billy Reid on a very limited collection inspired by the iconic Gibson Hummingbird™ guitar. For this crewneck sweater, Billy Reid took extra-fine Merino wool and knitted Billy’s original “Kissing Hummingbirds” design on the back and shoulders using an intarsia technique (a true sign of craftsmanship). Featuring raglan sleeves, this collectible sweater will quickly become your cold-weather favorite. 100% Merino wool Made in China Dry clean only Model is 6'2" wearing size M Standard fit Relaxed through the chest, body, and sleeves

data.title: Lifestyle Billy Reid x Gibson Embroidered Denim Shirt
data.description: Straight from Muscle Shoals to Music Row, and now, to you, Gibson has partnered with award-winning Florence, Alabama-based fashion designer Billy Reid on a very limited collection inspired by the iconic Gibson Hummingbird™ guitar. For this special edition of Billy Reid’s iconic Shoals Shirt, they chain stitched our exclusive collaboration pattern—designed by Billy himself—to the upper chest and back. A true mark of craftsmanship, this chain stitch was applied individually by hand in the USA, giving each one a unique character. They then finished this shirt with antique brass snaps at the chest and placket and their distinctive ribbon stitching at the left breast pocket. 100% Cotton Made in China Machine wash cold inside-out. Hang dry Model is 6'2" wearing size M Slim fit Fitted through the chest, body, and sleeves For a more relaxed fit, size up one size

For this Western Shirt, Billy Reid took one of their favorite heritage styles and gave it a jacquard print of our exclusive collaboration pattern, designed by Billy himself and woven in France. data.title: Lifestyle Billy Reid x Gibson Hummingbird Dress
data.description: Straight from Muscle Shoals to Music Row, and now, to you, Gibson has partnered with award-winning Florence, Alabama-based fashion designer Billy Reid on a very limited collection inspired by the iconic Gibson Hummingbird™ guitar. Modeled after the style of certain iconic singer-songwriters, this tiered prairie dress features our exclusive Hummingbird wallpaper pattern, designed by Billy himself. Easy to dress up or down, this style is a chic statement piece that’s also super wearable. 56% Cotton, 44% Viscose Made in the USA Machine wash cold inside-out. Hang dry Model is 6'2" wearing size M Standard fit

data.title: Lifestyle Gibson Gives x MusiCares Music on a Mission Sweatshirt
data.description: This ultra-soft and comfortable gray tri-blend fleece fabric sweatshirt features Gibson x MusiCares cobranding celebrating the Music on a Mission livestream event. The Music on a Mission virtual concert will be held on March 30, 2022, benefiting MusiCares, the Recording Academy® (Grammy®) charitable arm. Offering preventive, emergency, and recovery programs, MusiCares is a safety net supporting the health and welfare of the music community. Proceeds from the sale of Gibson Gives x Music on a Mission apparel items will go to MusiCares. Unisex sizing, classic fit 50% polyester, 38% cotton, 12% rayon Care instructions: Cold water wash only, with like colors, on a delicate spin. Low heat dry is best to help protect the fabric.

data.title: Lifestyle Gibson Gives x MusiCares Music on a Mission Hoodie
data.description: This ultra-soft and comfortable charcoal pullover tri-blend fleece fabric hoodie features Gibson x MusiCares cobranding celebrating the Music on a Mission livestream event. The Music on a Mission virtual concert will be held on March 30, 2022, benefiting MusiCares, the Recording Academy® (Grammy®) charitable arm. Offering preventive, emergency, and recovery programs, MusiCares is a safety net supporting the health and welfare of the music community. Proceeds from the sale of Gibson Gives x Music on a Mission apparel items will go to MusiCares. Unisex sizing 50% polyester, 38% cotton, 12% rayon Care instructions: Cold water wash only, with like colors, on a delicate spin. Low heat dry is best to help protect the fabric.
